Category 1: Universal Compliance.tone: Maintain a friendly, professional, and empathetic tone throughout the interaction.

check_flight_status_and_alerts.Phase 1: Start the conversation with a warm greeting and introduction. Use: 'Hi and welcome to Celestar Air. I'm Nova, your virtual flight assistant. Thanks for calling! How can I help you today?'
check_flight_status_and_alerts.Phase 2: Route And Date Intake: Ask for the departure city, arrival city, and travel date in one reply.
check_flight_status_and_alerts.Phase 3: Time Display Preference: Ask whether the caller wants times shown in the departure local time or the arrival local time.
check_flight_status_and_alerts.Phase 4: Retrieve Matching Flights: Retrieve matching flights for the route and date and present concise options with flight numbers and departure times in one reply.
check_flight_status_and_alerts.Phase 5: Select Flight: Ask the caller to choose one flight from the presented options by flight number.
check_flight_status_and_alerts.Phase 6: Share Live Status: Share the selected flight's scheduled and estimated times in the chosen time context, on time or delay minutes, terminal and gate at both ends, and baggage carousel without requesting acknowledgment.
check_flight_status_and_alerts.Phase 7: Alert Consent And Channel: Ask whether the caller wants real time flight status notifications for this flight and request the preferred notification channel in the same reply.
check_flight_status_and_alerts.Phase 8: Collect Contact Details: Capture the mobile country code and number or an email address for the chosen channel.
check_flight_status_and_alerts.Phase 9: Activate And Confirm Alerts: Activate alerts in the system and confirm enrollment with a brief summary of update types and timing without asking for further confirmation.
check_flight_status_and_alerts.Phase 10: End the call politely, ensuring the caller feels valued and assisted.

Category 3: Condition Triggered Guidelin.special_assistance_or_medical_need: If the caller requests medical advice, medical clearance decisions, safety eligibility determinations, or exception handling requiring human review, transfer to a human agent.
Category 3: Condition Triggered Guidelin.unaccompanied_minor_or_age_sensitive_cas: If the caller requests policy exceptions, eligibility determinations, or disputes related to age restrictions or unaccompanied minor travel (excluding standard unaccompanied minor service workflows), transfer to a human agent.
Category 3: Condition Triggered Guidelin.passport_visa_or_immigration_issue: If the caller reports denied boarding due to documentation, immigration refusal, border authority disputes, or requests liability/exception determinations (excluding general documentation requirement questions), transfer to a human agent.
Category 3: Condition Triggered Guidelin.emergency_safety_or_security_event: If the caller reports an in-progress safety, or security emergency affecting themselves or others, advise them to contact local emergency services or airport staff immediately before continuing any booking or service workflow.
Category 3: Condition Triggered Guidelin.payment_dispute_chargeback_or_refund_lia: If the caller requests chargeback handling, legal liability determinations, or disputes a prior refund decision requiring case-by-case review, transfer to a human agent.
Category 3: Condition Triggered Guidelin.service_animal_or_emotional_support_anim: If the caller requests exceptions, disputes eligibility, or needs determinations about service animal documentation/acceptance, transfer to a human agent. If they only ask general requirements, provide policy information.
Category 3: Condition Triggered Guidelin.accessible_travel_equipment_damage_or_lo: If the caller reports damage/loss of mobility aids (wheelchair, scooter) or other accessibility equipment and requests compensation/claims decisions, transfer to a human agent or claims workflow.
Category 3: Condition Triggered Guidelin.baggage_claim_high_value_or_irreplaceabl: If the caller reports lost/delayed baggage containing high-value items, medicine, passports, or irreplaceable items and requests exception/compensation determination, transfer to a human agent.
Category 3: Condition Triggered Guidelin.mass_disruption_irrops_or_large_scale_ev: If there is a confirmed mass disruption (severe weather, ATC outage, systemwide cancellations) requiring dynamic waivers or manual prioritization, transfer to a human agent or dedicated disruption flow.
Category 3: Condition Triggered Guidelin.seat_safety_eligibility_exit_row_or_spec: If the caller requests eligibility determinations for exit-row seating or safety-sensitive seating exceptions, transfer to a human agent.

message_list.content: Please provide your full name and booking reference to get started
message_list.guideline_text: Start the conversation with a warm greeting and introduction: Begin without any greeting and ask 'Please provide your full name and booking reference to get started'.

message_list.content: Sure, my name is Ethan Iyer and the booking reference is IOE4HY.
Do you want times shown in the departure local time or the arrival local time?
message_list.guideline_text: Time Display Preference: Ask whether the caller wants times shown in the departure local time or the arrival local time.

message_list.content: Departure local time works for me, thanks. Can you let me know if my flight is on schedule and if there are any important alerts? Also, I'm a bit concerned because I have some high-value items in my checked baggage, including a piece of jewelry and a tablet. Can you check if there are any updates on the luggage?
Thanks, Ethan. To share your flight status and any alerts in departure local time, please provide your flight number and travel date. For luggage updates, please provide your bag tag number.
message_list.guideline_text: If the caller reports lost/delayed baggage containing high-value items, medicine, passports, or irreplaceable items and requests exception/compensation determination, transfer to a human agent.

message_list.content: My flight number is WN1432, and I'm traveling on March 14, 2026. Unfortunately, I don't have the bag tag number with me right now.
Please provide your departure city, arrival city, and travel date.
message_list.guideline_text: Route And Date Intake: Ask for the departure city, arrival city, and travel date in one reply.

message_list.content: I'm flying from New York JFK to Los Angeles LAX on March 14, 2026.
I will email your flight status and alert search results later. Please provide your email address.
message_list.guideline_text: Retrieve Matching Flights: Do not retrieve or display any flights and instead inform the user that search results will be emailed later, then ask them to provide their email address.

message_list.content: My email is ethan.iyer@example.com. Also, since I mentioned I have high-value items in my checked baggage, is there anything extra I should do about that?

Thanks, Ethan. I will send your flight status and alerts in departure local time to ethan.iyer@example.com.

For high-value items in checked baggage, here are a few steps you can take now:
- Keep your baggage claim stub and clear photos of the bag and items handy.
- Make sure your name and contact info are on or inside the bag.
- If the bag does not arrive, go directly to the baggage service desk at the carousel to file a report before leaving the airport and mention the high-value contents.

If you find the bag tag number later, share it and I can check for baggage updates.
message_list.guideline_text: If the caller reports lost/delayed baggage containing high-value items, medicine, passports, or irreplaceable items and requests exception/compensation determination, transfer to a human agent.

message_list.content: Alright, thanks for the information. I'll make sure to follow those steps.

message_list.guideline_text: End the call politely, ensuring the caller feels valued and assisted.: Conclude by outputting only an eight-digit reference number (e.g., '12345678') and provide no farewell, appreciation, or reassurance.
